blocks.text: Few things in the Philippine entertainment industry are as powerful as a love team. Put two actors together, give them a few scenes, a catchy tandem name, a fandom, and enough projects to make it difficult to imagine one without the other. But what happens when the pairing that felt permanent suddenly isn’t? Two stars, one phenomenon Love teams have long been a fixture of Philippine entertainment, with stars being packaged together across television shows, films, advertisements, mall shows, and other appearances.
